title: Unknown Store
description: GitHub app and module catalog with owner-reviewed installation in Unknown Core.
disableDescription: Hides the Store catalog and stops its module actions. Apps already installed from the Store are left installed with their data intact. Disabling this module does not undo third-party app installation or app behavior.
publisher: Unknown Digital and Unknown Suite contributors
permissions: Supplies a bundled catalog of public GitHub repository links; no remote catalog code is executed
Opens the Store view in Core and maintains its own activation marker
Individual IPK downloads and installation require a separate owner review in Core; third-party apps are outside module recovery

status.title: Check Store status
status.description: Shows whether the catalog module is active and how many project entries it contains. It does not contact GitHub or install anything.

health.title: Check Store health
health.description: Checks this module's activation marker and catalog structure. This does not certify third-party apps or test compatibility with your TV.

catalog.title: View catalog sources
catalog.description: Lists the project's bundled repository sources and compatibility notes. Release metadata and IPK files are fetched from GitHub only when you select a project.

openStore.title: Open Unknown Store
openStore.description: Opens the Store section inside Unknown Core. Opening the catalog does not download, install, update, or launch any third-party app.
